A '''range trooper''' served in the [[Galactic Empire]] and was stationed at [[Sienar Test Facility 73]] in [[4 BBY]].

==Biography==
An individual served as a [[range trooper]] under the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 BBY]], they were [[Sienar Test Facility 73 defense battalion|stationed]] at [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[Sienar Test Facility 73|Test Facility 73]]<ref name="OYL" /> on the [[planet]] [[Sienar TF73]]<ref name="DatabankSienar73" /> alongside other several other range troopers and [[stormtrooper]]s. During this time, the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Spy|operative]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] had [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|infiltrated]] the facility to steal the prototype [[TIE Avenger]], aided by a [[Defector|turncoat]] worker in the facility named [[Niya]]. While Andor successfully entered the [[starfighter]], he struggled to fly the experimental [[Starship|ship]] due to its unconventional systems. The ensuing noise he created drew the attention of multiple stormtroopers, who, upon realizing the ship had been compromised, opened fire on it. As Andor was able to kill many of the troopers with his stolen craft's rotary [[blaster]]s and [[missile]]s, the range trooper, the last Imperial [[soldier]] left standing, attempted to destroy the Avenger with a [[Smart Rocket]]. However, Andor managed to dip his craft barely out of the way as the trooper fired. As the trooper reloaded, Andor seized the opportunity and used the [[TIE series|TIE]]'s [[heavy laser cannon]] to partially burn through the [[hangar]]'s [[blast door]], and disintegrating the trooper who was standing in its path.<ref name="OYL" />

==Equipment==
The range trooper used the standard range trooper [[vambrace armor]] and brandished a Smart Rocket.<ref name="OYL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The trooper appeared in the [[One Year Later|first episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="OYL" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
